sources.title: Cronologia vinciana (1502–1503)
sources.organization: Urbino University Press — Università degli Studi di Urbino Carlo Bo
sources.locator: Gianni Volpe, in Leonardo a Urbino (2023), printed p. 16: Manuscript L folios 78r, 46v and 66v for the dated Rimini, Cesena and Cesenatico entries; note 26 for the full 18 August 1502 letter-patent transcription and dating formula
intended_claims: Manuscript L folio 78r contains the dated Rimini observation for 8 August 1502
Manuscript L folio 46v contains the Cesena entry for 10 August 1502
Manuscript L folio 66v contains the dated Cesenatico entry for 6 September 1502 at 15:00
The transcribed letter patent is dated at Pavia on 18 August 1502 and names Leonardo architect and engineer general

rights.attribution: Gianni Volpe, Cronologia vinciana (1502–1503), in Leonardo a Urbino, Urbino University Press, 2023

sources.title: Leonardo da Vinci and Cesare Borgia: ingenuity and intellect at the service of the duchy
sources.locator: Sections introductory context, Rimini, Cesena and Cesenatico; dated itinerary statements, Cesena wall-survey folios 9r–10r and a separate Cesenatico perspective described at folio 68r
intended_claims: The institutional itinerary dates Leonardo's Rimini note to 8 August 1502
The itinerary places Leonardo in Cesena on 10 August 1502 and associates the survey with Manuscript L folios 9r–10r
The itinerary dates the Cesenatico port observation to 6 September 1502 and separately describes a perspective at Manuscript L folio 68r
The itinerary dates Cesare Borgia's letter patent to 18 August 1502
